title: AAPS crash when activating local profile
body:
In AAPS I used the profile helper function to generate a local profile. I used the DPV profile and copied the results to my local profile list. Using the default generated name of the profile (very long name incl date, time etc) causess AAPS to crash once the profile is activated. Changeing the name to something simple solves the issue. 
I think automatically generated profile names should not crash the software.

This is with AAPS 3.0.0.1 and android 10.
